title: metrics.record
description: LIVE. A product event as a firm records it (modules/metrics), on the firm's own bus and, when the firm is openly operated, on the hub through `events.publish` with the publication envelope. The detail-type is the event's own name (`account.signed_up`, `loaf.baked`), an open vocabulary, so no channel projects it by kind; the operator's counter counts a published firm's event under its partition (count, count_distinct and sum at day, week and month, keyed by the public metric key) and serves a set's size, never a member.

customer_id.description: The firm the event belongs to; the partition it counts under.

zone.description: The firm's IANA zone at record time; the periods are cut in it.

ts.description: The instant, UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds and a Z, as the store keys it.

properties.description: The event's scalars as strings, the owner's vocabulary.

via.description: Which producer recorded it: the door, a record_metric rule, the agent's tool, or the ledger (a posting's line).

subject_id.description: Who or what took the step, the firm's own contact id, account id or device id: a person reference, never published on a channel; the platform holds it to count distinct subjects and never serves it.

caller.description: The door's source name, when the event came through the door.

rule_exec_id.description: The rule execution, when a record_metric rule recorded it.

openly_operated.description: The publication envelope: the firm's flag at the put. Always true on the hub, since `publish` withholds otherwise.
